  let i1 ← Array.index_usize digits 1#usize
  let c ← aspis_core.field.CM31.new i i1
  let i2 ← Array.index_usize digits 2#usize
  let i3 ← Array.index_usize digits 3#usize
  let c1 ← aspis_core.field.CM31.new i2 i3
  let i4 ← Array.index_usize digits 4#usize
  let i5 ← Array.index_usize digits 5#usize
  let c2 ← aspis_core.field.CM31.new i4 i5
  let i6 ← Array.index_usize digits 6#usize
  let i7 ← Array.index_usize digits 7#usize
  let c3 ← aspis_core.field.CM31.new i6 i7
  aspis_core.field.wide_exact.WideExact.new { c0 := c, c1 }
    { c0 := c2, c1 := c3 }

/-- [pv_cb3_source::sampler::add_small_base_p]: loop body 0:
    Source: '../source/crates/aspis-r1-cost-probe/src/sampler.rs', lines 91:4-95:5 -/
@[rust_loop_body]
def sampler.add_small_base_p_loop.body
  (iter : core.slice.iter.IterMut Std.U32)
  (back : core.slice.iter.IterMut Std.U32 → core.slice.iter.IterMut Std.U32)
  (addend : Std.U32) :
  Result (ControlFlow ((core.slice.iter.IterMut Std.U32) ×
    (core.slice.iter.IterMut Std.U32 → core.slice.iter.IterMut Std.U32) ×
    Std.U32) (Std.U32 × (core.slice.iter.IterMut Std.U32 →
    core.slice.iter.IterMut Std.U32)))
  := do
  let (o, iter1, next_back) ← core.slice.iter.IteratorIterMut.next iter
  match o with
  | none => ok (done (addend, fun im => let im1 := next_back im none
                                        back im1))
  | some digit =>
    let i ← lift (core.convert.num.FromU64U32.from digit)
    let i1 ← lift (core.convert.num.FromU64U32.from addend)
    let sum ← lift (Std.U64.wrapping_add i i1)
    let i2 ← lift (core.convert.num.FromU64U32.from aspis_core.field.P)
    let i3 ← sum % i2
    let digit1 ← lift (UScalar.cast .U32 i3)
    let i4 ← lift (core.convert.num.FromU64U32.from aspis_core.field.P)
    let i5 ← sum / i4
    let addend1 ← lift (UScalar.cast .U32 i5)
    ok (cont (iter1, fun im => let im1 := next_back im (some digit1)
                               back im1, addend1))

/-- [pv_cb3_source::sampler::add_small_base_p]: loop 0:
    Source: '../source/crates/aspis-r1-cost-probe/src/sampler.rs', lines 91:4-95:5 -/
@[rust_loop]
def sampler.add_small_base_p_loop
  (iter : core.slice.iter.IterMut Std.U32)
  (back : core.slice.iter.IterMut Std.U32 → core.slice.iter.IterMut Std.U32)
  (addend : Std.U32) :
  Result (Std.U32 × (core.slice.iter.IterMut Std.U32 →
    core.slice.iter.IterMut Std.U32))
  := do
  loop
    (fun (iter1, back1, addend1) => sampler.add_small_base_p_loop.body iter1
      back1 addend1)
    (iter, back, addend)

/-- [pv_cb3_source::sampler::add_small_base_p]:
    Source: '../source/crates/aspis-r1-cost-probe/src/sampler.rs', lines 90:0-98:1 -/
def sampler.add_small_base_p
  (digits : Array Std.U32 8#usize) (addend : Std.U32) :
  Result (Bool × (Array Std.U32 8#usize))
  := do
  let (iter, into_iter_back) ←
    MutAArray.Insts.CoreIterTraitsCollectIntoIteratorMutATIterMut.into_iter
      digits
  let (addend1, back) ←
    sampler.add_small_base_p_loop iter (fun im => im) addend
  let digits1 := into_iter_back back
  ok (addend1 != 0#u32, digits1)

/-- [pv_cb3_source::sampler::gamma_sample]:
    Source: '../source/crates/aspis-r1-cost-probe/src/sampler.rs', lines 111:0-119:1
    Visibility: public -/
def sampler.gamma_sample
  (block : Array Std.U8 32#usize) :
  Result aspis_core.field.wide_exact.WideExact
  := do
  let (digits, quotient) ← sampler.low_base_p_digits block
  let i ← lift (Std.U32.wrapping_add quotient 1#u32)
  let (wrapped, digits1) ← sampler.add_small_base_p digits i
  let digits2 ←
    if wrapped
    then
      do
      let (_, digits3) ← sampler.add_small_base_p digits1 1#u32
      ok digits3
    else ok digits1
  sampler.decode8 digits2

/-- [pv_cb3_source::gamma_sample]:
    Source: 'lib.rs', lines 21:0-21:98
    Visibility: public -/
def gamma_sample
  (block : Array Std.U8 32#usize) :
  Result aspis_core.field.wide_exact.WideExact
  := do
  sampler.gamma_sample block
